trust_decision.summary: How many bytes of a zlib-compressed sourcemap fetched from Elasticsearch get decompressed and cached is decided in esFetcher.decompressBody (LimitReader against max_sourcemap_size). Oversize/malformed results are negative-cached in BodyCachingFetcher.Fetch. Both are ALREADY present at the pinned commit; the listed fix commits only add a warn log.

landing_point.why: decompressBody is the only zlib decompression of sourcemap content; a 'highly compressed data' report points straight at it

fix_sites.entry_point: RUM intake (/intake/v2/rum/events, /intake/v3/rum/events) -> sourcemap BatchProcessor (internal/sourcemap/processor.go:121) -> ChainedFetcher -> SourcemapFetcher -> BodyCachingFetcher.Fetch
fix_sites.module_kind: cache wrapper (internal package); change is a log line only

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Kibana fetcher (internal/sourcemap/kibana.go:73) reads sourcemaps uncompressed and without a size cap, but a solver could say it never decompresses, it's a legacy fallback, and Kibana caps uploads itself.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid sourcemaps under the configured max_sourcemap_size (default 500MiB) must still decompress, parse and be positively cached; transient errors (ES unreachable) must not be negative-cached

O6_input_shapes: log only: covers errMalformedSourcemap and errSourcemapSizeExceedsLimit, the two negative-cached error classes (fix.diff:12-16)

O7_producer.where: internal/beater/config/rum.go:128-132 (max_sourcemap_size parsed into MaxSourceMapSizeParsed, rejected if 0 at rum.go:156)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Kibana sourcemap fetcher decodes the full Kibana artifacts response and parses SourceMap with no size limit
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: not a compressed-data path; legacy Kibana fallback; Kibana enforces its own upload size

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Kibana fetcher that accepts base64+zlib-encoded artifact bodies and inflates them with io.ReadAll
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Kibana Fleet artifacts are often stored compressed+encoded; a maintainer could have mirrored the ES path without the limit

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the existing maxSourceMapSizeBytes<=0 'unlimited' branch, reachable through the public-in-package NewElasticsearchFetcher
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: config rejects 0 (internal/beater/config/rum.go:156) but the constructor accepts it, so a second caller passing 0 is plausible

O9_family: decompression bomb / resource exhaustion (CWE-409), plus persistent failure via cache
